source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper works under completely randomized/exchangeable assignment, resolves rank ties by a randomly ordered index tie-breaker, and gives a valid closed-form worst-case rank p-value under general missingness.

The published article is by Siyu Heng, Jiawei Zhang, and Yang Feng and is titled “Design-Based Causal Inference with Missing Outcomes: Missingness Mechanisms, Imputation-Assisted Randomization Tests, and Covariate Adjustment”; it develops imputation-and-re-imputation exact randomization tests and confidence regions.
The cited paper exists at the stated venue and develops finite-sample FRT p-value-function inversion with guaranteed confidence coverage.
The paper develops a two-sample Wilcoxon–Mann–Whitney extension with exact statistic bounds under arbitrary missing values, rather than an assignment-weighted Fisher-tail optimizer.
The paper establishes bounded-null randomization inference and exact inversion for maxima, minima, and quantiles of individual effects using effect-increasing statistics.
